state.task: sign in to the demo shop

can: Click one link, button, tab, menu item, checkbox, radio button, switch, or list option per step
Go back to the previous page
See every element on the page through the accessibility snapshot, so scrolling is never needed
Type any value listed in `values` into a text box, then press Enter
cannot: Hover, drag, upload, or download files
Write answers or summaries; it only navigates, and success means ending on the right page
Type anything that is not listed in `values`, or enter URLs
Log in without a username and password in `values`, create accounts, or solve CAPTCHAs

blocked.instructions: Does reaching `task` from `page` require an action listed in `agent.cannot`?

criteria.true: Every remaining route needs an action the agent cannot do, such as solving a CAPTCHA or typing a value not listed in `values`
criteria.false: A route of clicks, typing from `values`, and back steps could plausibly reach the task

done.instructions: Is `page` the state that `task` asks for, with everything `task` asks to be done already done?

criteria.true: The page is the target itself, and every value `task` names - a place, a date, a count, a sort order, a submitted form - shows on it
criteria.false: The page only mentions or links to the target, is a different page, or shows a value that differs from one `task` names

rules: Only pick actions allowed by `agent.can`. An element that leads to something in `agent.cannot`, such as a search button with nothing to type, does not help.
Prefer an element whose target is the task itself over elements that only relate to it.
`history` lists what has already been done. Do not repeat an action that did not get closer.
Type a value from `values` only into the box it belongs in. After typing, press Enter or click the submit button.
If typing opened a list of suggestions, click the option matching the typed value before moving to another box, or the site discards the value.
A field that already shows the right value is done. Do not type into it again.
instructions.task: Pick the action that makes the most progress toward `task`.

criteria.back: Go back to the previous page
criteria.none: None of these actions makes progress toward the task
